Class MemoryTelemetry

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.MemoryTelemetry
public class MemoryTelemetry extends Object
The MemoryTelemetry is a frozen copy of the process counters. The object stores pages allocated, pages spilled, frames appended, and index rows. The object stores reader retries, checksum failures, and stale reads. The object stores spill bytes, spill time, and lock-wait time. The object stores hot used bytes and spilled used bytes. The object stores a fragmentation index. Later increments stay on the live counters. This object does not change after it is built. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MemoryTelemetry roux-design.md

  • Constructor Details

    • MemoryTelemetry

      public MemoryTelemetry(long pagesAllocated, long pagesSpilled, long framesAppended, long indexEntries, long seqlockRetries, long dirtyFrames, long staleViews, long spillBytes, long spillNanos, long lockWaitNanos, long usedBytesHot, long usedBytesSpilled, double fragmentationIndex)
      The constructor stores one snapshot of the process counters.
      Parameters:
      pagesAllocated - The count is the number of pages created.
      pagesSpilled - The count is the number of pages written out of memory.
      framesAppended - The count is the number of frames written.
      indexEntries - The count is the number of index rows.
      seqlockRetries - The count is the number of reader retries.
      dirtyFrames - The count is the number of checksum failures.
      staleViews - The count is the number of reads that missed a live page.
      spillBytes - The count is the number of bytes written out of memory.
      spillNanos - The time is the nanoseconds spent writing those bytes.
      lockWaitNanos - The time is the nanoseconds spent waiting for a lock.
      usedBytesHot - The count is the hot used bytes at the snapshot.
      usedBytesSpilled - The count is the spilled used bytes at the snapshot.
      fragmentationIndex - The index is the fragmentation value the caller computed.
